scenes.title: A ride past the breakwater
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn offers a daylight crossing for two silver and says she will be at pier four tomorrow at first light. She says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: The hymn pages in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm floodwater and hymn pages marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as his sister Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren of involvement with the choir; Oren takes two damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing.

scenes.title: Tomorrow we dive
scenes.summary: The party plans to leave with Sela at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa intends to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
